I'm sorry, Neil. Your Thor P2 still hasn't shipped. The Canada units Georges told you on October 13 would land the following week haven't been checked in yet. Our Canadian warehouse still has none, and the Thor P2 page now shows Canadian orders shipping by November 30.

I know that's a long way from the order you placed on September 8. I've passed this to the team so they can confirm a firm date for you. Please stay in the chat and one of them will reply here. If you step away, the answer will go to your iCloud email.

You can watch the incoming shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
